terms.title: CimessFruit terms and conditions
terms.summary: Your agreement for shopping with CimessFruit, part of the CimessInvest organisation. Covers accounts, food orders, payment, delivery, refunds and applicable rights.

sections.title: 1. CimessFruit and the CimessInvest organisation
paragraphs: CimessFruit is the fruit, plantain, smoothie and related food shopping service within the CimessInvest organisation. It is available through the CimessFruit mobile application and the authorised CimessFruit subdomain of cimessinvest.com. These terms concern that store and its customer services. They do not enrol you as a merchant on the wider CimessInvest platform or grant a licence to operate a storefront.

In this document, “CimessFruit”, “the store”, “we”, “us” and “our” refer to the CimessFruit operation within CimessInvest, as applicable to the service being provided. “You” means a customer, an authorised person placing an order, or a visitor. A brand name or subdomain does not, by itself, create a separate legal entity or remove responsibilities imposed by law.

The organisation contact details supplied for these services are CimessInvest, 54, Olude Bustop, Ipaja, Lagos, Nigeria; telephone +234 808 927 3565; and email support@cimessinvest.com. You may use the same contact for CimessFruit complaints and privacy requests. In-app Support provides an additional channel for order-specific assistance. Keep your order reference when contacting us.

sections.title: 2. Scope of the agreement and related policies
paragraphs: These terms cover browsing the catalogue, registering an account, submitting an order, using store support, requesting a remedy, and accessing the application and website. The Privacy policy explains personal data handling. The Cancellations and refunds policy and Delivery information explain those operational processes in more detail. Read the documents together with the information presented for your particular order.

Any mandatory protection under applicable law prevails over a conflicting term. An order-specific description, price, delivery charge or promise accepted for your purchase cannot be retrospectively withdrawn by a later general policy. Where documents appear inconsistent, contact us for an explanation; the inconsistency does not permit us to select whichever wording removes a protection owed to you.

These terms apply to CimessFruit, even where the broader CimessInvest platform hosts independent merchants. General statements that a technology platform never sells goods, handles complaints or arranges refunds must not be used to disclaim the responsibilities arising from CimessFruit’s own store activities. Other storefronts may have their own identified sellers and contracts; ordering here does not create a contract with every business on the parent platform.

sections.title: 3. Reading, acceptance and changes
paragraphs: Read the applicable terms before creating an account or submitting an order. Where the interface asks you to agree to the terms, that action indicates your agreement to the version presented. Merely opening the Privacy policy is not consent to every possible use of personal information, optional marketing, or an unrelated future service. Separate choices remain separate.

We may revise these documents to reflect changes in the store, law or service operation. The version identifier and revision date help you identify the text you are reading. Material changes should be brought to your attention through the service or an appropriate account communication before they apply to continuing use. A new policy must not rewrite a completed transaction or extinguish an existing refund entitlement.

You can save or print the website version and retain your order records. If you cannot access the current text, contact us for a readable copy. An outage, an inaccessible link or failure to receive a notification does not itself mean that you have accepted an undisclosed change. Where fresh agreement is legally required, continued access alone is not a substitute for it.

sections.title: 4. Eligibility and authority to order
paragraphs: Account registration and purchasing are intended for adults aged 18 or over who can enter into the transaction. If you order for another adult or for a business, you must have authority to provide the necessary details, authorise payment and arrange receipt. You must not misrepresent your identity, age, authority or relationship with the organisation.

Keep information relevant and accurate, particularly contact details, the delivery location and any instructions needed for safe fulfilment. A person receiving an order should know it is being delivered. Do not enter another person’s information to harass them, create an unwanted delivery, obtain access to their account or claim their refund.

If an account appears to have been created by a child or without authority, contact us. We may restrict affected functions while the situation is reviewed and handle related data appropriately. An eligibility restriction does not justify keeping money for goods we will not supply or refusing an otherwise valid complaint.

sections.title: 5. Accounts, passwords and recovery
paragraphs: Use a password you do not share with other people or reuse across sensitive services. Keep your device and email account reasonably secure, sign out on shared devices, and tell us promptly if you suspect unauthorised access. Do not share a password, recovery link, verification code or session credential with someone claiming to be support staff.

Email verification, password reset and account reactivation may require a code or a secure link. Follow the instructions and expiry shown in the message. Request a new code if necessary rather than repeatedly using an expired one. We may limit repeated attempts to protect accounts. These checks do not require you to disclose your banking password or a bank-issued payment authorisation code to the store.

You are responsible for instructions you authorise and reasonable care of your account. You are not automatically responsible for every action recorded under your name regardless of its cause. Report disputed account activity so we can examine the circumstances, preserve relevant records, and address security failures or legal duties for which we are responsible.

sections.title: 6. Third-party sign-in and identity providers
paragraphs: Where Google sign-in is offered, the identity provider authenticates you and supplies the profile information permitted by that flow. Review the permissions presented by the provider. Signing in does not give us general access to your email inbox, private messages, social contacts or unrelated files, and these terms do not authorise such access.

Your relationship with the identity provider is governed by its applicable terms and privacy information. If its service is unavailable, sign-in through that provider may also be unavailable. Contact support about access problems; do not create duplicate orders or send a second payment simply because a sign-in or account screen did not refresh.

The presence of a social link or share button does not imply an integration with every social network. Functions described on another CimessInvest storefront, including merchant imports or social commerce tools, are not necessarily part of CimessFruit. Only permissions and functions actually offered for this app apply.

sections.title: 7. Catalogue descriptions and natural variation
paragraphs: The catalogue identifies the available products, options, prices and stock shown by the store. Select the correct item, size and quantity before checkout. Fruit and other natural produce can vary in appearance, ripeness and shape; photographs illustrate the product and do not promise that every individual item will look identical to the image.

Natural variation is not an excuse to deliver a different product, materially short quantities, spoiled goods, or something inconsistent with a material description. Stated weights, volumes, sizes and ingredients must be presented honestly. If a description is unclear, ask before ordering rather than relying on a photograph to establish an exact weight or a characteristic that has not been stated.

Descriptions such as fresh, organic, sugar-free or suitable for a particular dietary need must have an appropriate factual basis when used. General fruit information is not a diagnosis, treatment, or promise of a health outcome. A product should not be treated as a medicine because of an informal description, a customer comment or a claim made on an unrelated website.

sections.title: 8. Ingredients, allergies and dietary requirements
paragraphs: Review any available ingredient and allergen information before ordering a smoothie or prepared food. If an ingredient, preparation method or possible contact with another food matters to you, ask the store for confirmation before paying. Do not assume that an ingredient is absent solely because it is not visible in a product photograph.

Tell us only the information needed to explain your requirement. You do not need to upload a medical history or diagnosis to ask whether a product contains an ingredient. A dietary request is not accepted merely because it was typed into a free-text field; obtain confirmation that the store can meet it. If we cannot confirm safe suitability, do not rely on an unverified substitution or instruction.

We remain responsible for accurate information we provide and for duties relating to food safety. These precautions do not transfer responsibility for misleading labels or unsafe preparation to the customer. If food appears unsafe, do not consume it to prove a complaint. Seek appropriate medical assistance for a health concern and report the order issue when you are able.

sections.title: 9. Prices, charges and promotional information
paragraphs: Prices and order totals are expressed in Nigerian naira unless the service expressly states otherwise. Checkout calculates the selected goods and the applicable delivery charge. Review the final payable amount, any approved credit applied and all disclosed charges before submitting an order or transferring money. Your bank may separately impose charges under its own terms.

A promotion applies only on its stated conditions, including eligible goods, quantity limits and any validity period. We should make a material restriction clear before the purchase. An advertised discount does not remove rights relating to goods that are unsafe, defective or materially different from what was described. Do not assume a promotion on a different CimessInvest storefront also applies here.

If we discover a material pricing or availability error, we will explain it and seek agreement to a correction or cancellation, taking account of the stage of the transaction and applicable law. We must not silently increase a saved payable amount or substitute a more expensive item. Money received for an order we cannot fulfil remains subject to the appropriate refund process.

sections.title: 10. Basket review and submitting an order
paragraphs: Adding an item to your basket does not by itself reserve stock or complete a purchase. The service checks the basket again during checkout. Review any stock, price, product or delivery warning and correct the basket before proceeding. The final saved order is the reference for the goods and amounts submitted, rather than an older catalogue screenshot.

An order reference acknowledges a recorded order and allows you to track its status. It does not, by itself, prove that a bank transfer has arrived or that delivery has been dispatched. Payment verification and fulfilment updates are shown separately. If an error interrupts checkout, inspect your order list or contact support before submitting the same intended purchase again.

Keep the order reference and the relevant payment confirmation from your bank. If there are duplicate orders, contact the store so the intended purchase can be identified. We will assess actual payments and reservations rather than treating an accidental duplicate screen submission as permission to charge for multiple purchases without clarification.

sections.title: 11. Stock reservations and unpaid orders
paragraphs: Saved orders may reserve stock while payment is pending. Under the current process, an unreported unpaid reservation expires after 24 hours and scheduled maintenance releases the reserved stock. A maintenance run or display update may occur after that point, so the continued appearance of a payment button is not permission to pay for an expired reservation.

Before transferring, reopen the saved order and check that it remains eligible for payment. Product availability, delivery coverage or the reservation’s age may affect eligibility. If the order warns you not to transfer, stop and contact support. A transfer reported for review is handled through that review process and should not be mistaken for an ordinary untouched unpaid reservation.

If you transferred before noticing an expiry, contact us with the reference and bank confirmation. Expiry does not mean that money received is forfeited. The store must reconcile what was received and agree whether the order can lawfully be fulfilled or the money should be returned. Do not attempt to restore an expired order by paying a second time.

sections.title: 12. Bank transfers and payment review
paragraphs: CimessFruit currently uses the manual bank-transfer instructions displayed for an eligible saved order. Use those instructions and the amount shown at the time you pay. We do not publish a bank account name or account number in these terms because payment instructions belong with the order and must be checked there. These terms do not promise card processing, escrow, automated merchant settlements or a particular payment gateway.

Selecting “I have paid” asks the store to review your transfer. It does not certify receipt, guarantee acceptance of a screenshot, or automatically mark the order paid. The store checks its payment records before updating the order. Bank processing, reconciliation and support review can take time; the order page is the place to check the recorded status.

Use only a payment source you are authorised to use. Never send a bank PIN, banking password, full card details or bank authorisation code in chat. If you suspect altered payment instructions or a request to pay an unfamiliar recipient outside the saved order, stop and verify through the organisation contact. Do not rely solely on an unsolicited message, screenshot or social-media account.

sections.title: 13. Payment discrepancies and corrections
paragraphs: Report an underpayment, overpayment, duplicate transfer, rejected payment report or unmatched transfer with your order reference and limited supporting details. A review outcome in the app is not a bank reversal. In particular, marking a reported payment rejected does not automatically return any money that may have reached the receiving account.

We may request information reasonably necessary to reconcile the transfer, such as its amount, time and reference. Redact unrelated balances and transactions from evidence where possible. We will distinguish between a genuine mismatch and a dishonest claim; a delayed or unclear bank confirmation alone should not be described as fraud without a reasonable basis.

Where a refund or correction is due, the store must explain the amount and the next step. Do not pay twice to clear an unresolved status unless the earlier transfer has been properly reconciled and you understand the correction. Disputed funds and records remain subject to applicable rights even if the order, account or application becomes unavailable.

sections.title: 14. Delivery coverage, addresses and estimates
paragraphs: Delivery is limited to the active zones and conditions offered at checkout. A saved map pin may be checked against a configured boundary. Location estimates and suggested addresses can be wrong, so confirm the street, house or entrance, phone number and helpful landmarks yourself. Do not transfer for a location that the order identifies as unsupported.

The delivery details saved with an order are its fulfilment instructions. Updating your profile afterwards does not automatically change an existing order. Contact support as soon as possible if a correction is needed; the store must confirm whether the change can be accommodated, whether the zone remains serviceable, and whether an agreed charge changes.

Delivery windows are estimates unless a specific guarantee is expressly agreed. Traffic, weather, preparation and access conditions can affect arrival. We should communicate a material delay and discuss a reasonable solution. Describing a time as an estimate does not permit indefinite non-delivery, disregard of a time-critical agreement, or refusal to consider a remedy for our failure.

sections.title: 15. Handover and unsuccessful delivery
paragraphs: Arrange for yourself or an authorised recipient to be reachable and able to receive the order at the agreed place. Give practical access instructions without disclosing unnecessary security credentials. A rider may need to contact you to locate the entrance. Do not ask a rider to enter an unsafe area or carry out an activity outside the agreed delivery.

If delivery cannot be completed, the store should record the reason and attempt to agree a next step. Any proposed redelivery charge must be explained before it is accepted. Responsibility depends on the circumstances, including whether the address was accurate, the recipient was available, and the store or rider followed the agreed instructions.

An app status marked “delivered” is a record that can be challenged if the goods were not received. Report discrepancies promptly. Leaving food unattended, handing it to a different person or treating a failed delivery as completed requires an appropriate basis; these terms do not create blanket permission to abandon perishables or deny a complaint without checking what happened.

sections.title: 16. Perishable goods and care after receipt
paragraphs: Inspect the delivery as soon as reasonably possible for missing items, a wrong product, visible damage, spoiled food or unsafe packaging. Follow the product’s handling instructions and use suitable storage promptly. Food quality can deteriorate when perishables are left in heat, contaminated, or stored for longer than is appropriate for the product.

If something appears unsafe, separate it from other food and contact the store. Keep relevant packaging or photographs when practical, but do not retain a hazardous item in a way that creates a health risk. Ask for instructions before transporting questionable food back to the store. We should consider reasonable evidence even where preserving the product is unsafe or impossible.

The fact that goods are perishable may affect whether a change-of-mind return is practical or legally required. It does not mean that all food sales are final regardless of defects. We will assess the condition at delivery, the description, handling after receipt and other relevant evidence fairly, without using a blanket “no refunds” rule to remove mandatory rights.

sections.title: 17. Cancellations and changes of mind
paragraphs: An unpaid order can normally be cancelled through its order page while the relevant action is available. If you have already transferred money, report that fact and contact support before cancelling or assuming the order’s cancellation will return the transfer. Cancelling a reservation and making a bank refund are different operations.

Once payment has been verified or preparation or delivery has started, contact the store to discuss cancellation or a change. Whether a charge is lawful and reasonable depends on the transaction, the work already undertaken and applicable rights. We must explain any proposed deduction and its basis, rather than inventing a cancellation penalty after you request a remedy.

We may refuse an unsupported change that would require different goods or a different delivery arrangement, while still dealing fairly with the original order and any money received. If the store cancels because it cannot supply the agreed goods, we will address the resulting refund or an alternative you expressly accept. You do not have to accept an undisclosed substitute merely to avoid losing your payment.

sections.title: 18. Wrong, missing, damaged or unsafe goods
paragraphs: Use in-app Support or the organisation contact to report a problem with the order reference and a clear description. For a perishable delivery, prompt contact is especially helpful because condition changes quickly. There is no universal minute-based complaint deadline in these terms that automatically removes a right concerning a hidden defect or another issue recognised by law.

Photographs of the affected goods, packaging and quantity can help, but evidence requirements should be proportionate. Do not include passwords, unrelated financial records or images of people without a good reason. If you cannot upload a photo or open a dispute screen, use another contact channel. A technical failure is not a reason to abandon a legitimate claim.

The appropriate outcome may include supplying missing items, replacement, an agreed reduction, a refund or another lawful remedy. The store will explain its assessment and the amount affected. Request a review if you disagree. Internal approval rules and the availability of an app button do not determine the full extent of your legal rights.

sections.title: 19. Approved credit and the 20-minute buying window
paragraphs: After an approved return or dispute resolution, the system can record an approved amount as return credit. Opening a complaint does not itself create credit or start the buying window. Approval starts the current 20-minute window for using the approved amount on another order; the interface initially presents the buy-again or credit option.

During that window, you may choose an available resolution or place an eligible replacement purchase. Credit used for a new unpaid order is reserved and is settled or released according to that order’s payment or cancellation outcome. You cannot spend an amount that is already reserved or locked for a refund. Only the approved balance is available; opening multiple requests does not multiply it.

Any unused eligible balance becomes due for manual bank refund after the window, including where credit or replacement was selected but not completed. The window concerns spending the credit, not a guarantee that a bank transfer will arrive within 20 minutes. It is not a deadline to complain, a forfeiture rule, or permission to force a new purchase where a refund is legally due. Ask support to record a refund preference if the default does not reflect your choice.

sections.title: 20. Manual refunds and delivery-fee adjustments
paragraphs: For a bank refund, provide accurate bank details through the designated refund form or the secure process confirmed by support. You must be authorised to nominate the recipient. The store may ask proportionate questions to prevent payment to an unintended person. Never provide a banking password, PIN or one-time bank authorisation code for a refund.

The store locks the relevant balance before making a manual transfer so it cannot also be spent. A completed refund record should correspond to a transfer actually made and a reference that can be checked. If a transfer is cancelled before payment, the internal lock may be released. Neither action is a substitute for reconciling the bank movement and the amount owed.

Support will explain the approved amount and expected processing steps, and should update you about a material delay. Delivery charges are assessed separately in the current workflow; an internal “not approved” flag does not override a legal entitlement to reimbursement. Tell us if the transfer amount, reference or receipt does not match. An outstanding refund is not cancelled merely because you disable your account.

sections.title: 21. Complaints, review and external redress
paragraphs: We encourage you to contact support first because it can often resolve a mistaken status or missing item quickly. Include your order reference, the issue, any relevant dates and the outcome you seek. If the first response does not address the issue, ask for an organisational review through cimessinvest@gmail.com and retain copies of the exchange.

An informal discussion is encouraged, not an absolute 30-day waiting period before you may protect your rights. You may complain to the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission about consumer issues or to the Nigeria Data Protection Commission about personal data matters, and pursue other competent bodies or courts where available. Urgent safety or legal action need not wait for our internal process.

We do not impose compulsory individual arbitration or a blanket waiver of collective remedies through these consumer terms. Mediation or arbitration may be considered by a separate, informed agreement where lawful and appropriate. Making a good-faith complaint, disputing our decision or contacting a regulator is not by itself a prohibited activity or a reason to retaliate against you.

sections.title: 22. Acceptable use and fraud prevention
paragraphs: Do not create false payment reports, manipulate refund evidence, take another person’s account, impersonate staff, threaten riders or support personnel, or intentionally submit orders designed to waste stock or disrupt the store. Do not use the service to facilitate unlawful goods, fraudulent transfers or conduct that infringes another person’s rights.

Do not interfere with access controls, attempt to read another customer’s orders, introduce malicious code, or overwhelm the service with unauthorised automated traffic. Reasonable use of accessibility tools is not prohibited. Restrictions on copying or technical inspection apply only to the extent lawful and do not remove rights that applicable law expressly permits.

We may investigate credible signs of abuse, preserve relevant evidence, limit affected functions and make lawful reports where justified. Measures should be proportionate to the risk and reviewed when circumstances change. Fraud controls must not become an indefinite hold on an undisputed refund or an excuse to disclose private information more widely than necessary.

sections.title: 23. Support messages, photographs and other submissions
paragraphs: You remain responsible for the accuracy and lawfulness of the messages and files you provide. Send material relevant to your order or request and take reasonable care not to reveal someone else’s private information. Do not upload unlawful, malicious, threatening or deliberately misleading content. We may remove or restrict abusive material while preserving records needed for a legitimate complaint or legal purpose.

You retain ownership of your original content. You grant the permissions reasonably needed for us and our service providers to receive, store, display to authorised staff, investigate and respond to it. Those permissions are limited by the purpose of the service and the Privacy policy. Sending a private complaint photograph does not give us an unrestricted advertising licence.

If we want to publish a testimonial, identifiable customer photograph or private message for promotion, we should obtain the appropriate separate permission. General suggestions may inform service improvements, but these terms do not assign every intellectual property right in your communications to us. A support conversation should not be treated as publicly available merely because it passes through the application.

sections.title: 24. Intellectual property and application licence
paragraphs: CimessInvest, CimessFruit and their respective licensors retain the rights they hold in software, branding, designs and original store content. Subject to these terms, you may use the application and website for authorised personal shopping and account management. Downloading the app does not transfer ownership of its code, catalogue photographs, trademarks or other protected material.

You may retain your own transaction records and a copy of these policies. Except where permission or law allows, do not reproduce the store’s branding as your own, sell copies of protected assets, or imply that an unrelated business is officially endorsed by the organisation. This does not prevent truthful references to your experience or lawful use of material for a complaint.

Report suspected infringement to cimessinvest@gmail.com with the material’s location, the right you claim and enough information to assess the complaint. We may contact the uploader and limit access while reviewing a credible report. Reports should be accurate and made in good faith; we will not assume that an allegation alone establishes ownership or infringement.

sections.title: 25. External services and links
paragraphs: The service uses external providers for functions such as authentication, hosting, email, image storage, maps and optional push delivery. An external website, bank or app store may have its own conditions. Review those conditions when using that provider. A link does not mean we endorse every statement or offer made on the destination website.

We remain responsible for our own representations and obligations even when a provider performs part of the service. A third-party outage may affect availability, but does not automatically eliminate your claim for an undelivered order or release us from data-protection duties associated with our choice and use of a provider.

Beware of lookalike domains, unsolicited refund links and accounts claiming to sell an investment under the CimessFruit name. Use the authorised app, the linked store website and the published organisation contact. A third party’s claim of affiliation should be verified rather than inferred from a logo or an email display name.

sections.title: 26. Privacy, location and optional permissions
paragraphs: The Privacy policy explains the information used for accounts, orders, deliveries, payment review, support, security and refunds. It also explains recipients, retention considerations and ways to exercise privacy rights. Acceptance of shopping terms is not blanket consent to unrelated sharing, indefinite retention, intrusive tracking or processing that needs a separate lawful basis.

Location permission supports delivery-pin and address functions when you use them. You can enter delivery details manually if you decline permission, although the store still needs a serviceable address to fulfil an order. Camera, photo-library and notification permissions are managed through the relevant feature and device settings. The store does not need a bank password or access to your contact list to deliver fruit.

For privacy questions, contact cimessinvest@gmail.com and state the request clearly. We may verify identity proportionately before disclosing account information or changing protected records. Do not send unnecessary identity documents at the outset. Account disabling and a personal-data erasure request are distinct, as explained below and in the Privacy policy.

sections.title: 27. Electronic communications and notifications
paragraphs: Order pages, support messages and account emails are important channels for service information. Keep your contact details current and check the saved order when a notification is delayed. A push message is a convenience and may be delayed, hidden by device settings or unavailable on a particular build. It is not the sole evidence of payment receipt, delivery or refund completion.

Optional catalogue or promotional notifications should remain separate from essential account and order communications. You can change available notification preferences and device permissions. Withdrawing a marketing choice does not cancel an order or prevent a necessary security or transaction message. We will not treat the mere act of opening this document as a marketing subscription.

Electronic records can evidence a transaction, but their legal effect depends on the circumstances and applicable law. Keep copies of important confirmations. If an electronic message appears to contradict the saved order or these terms, ask for clarification before sending money or relying on an instruction that could expose you to loss.

sections.title: 28. Availability, maintenance and technical errors
paragraphs: We aim to keep the store usable, but maintenance, network failures, device limitations or provider outages can interrupt access. Some features depend on a supported app version, an internet connection or a service configuration. We may update or retire a feature while making reasonable arrangements for existing orders, records and unresolved support matters.

If the application freezes or an action times out, check its recorded outcome before repeating a payment or order. A loading indicator or error screen does not conclusively establish whether the server saved the action. Contact support when the result is uncertain. We should correct inaccurate records and explain significant errors rather than using a technical fault to avoid a genuine obligation.

We do not guarantee uninterrupted access or compatibility with every device. Equally, there is no blanket exclusion of responsibility for every outage or software defect. Any lawful limitation is read subject to the consumer protections and liability provisions below. You may still use the organisation contact if the normal app channel is unavailable.

sections.title: 29. Account disabling, suspension and outstanding obligations
paragraphs: The current “Disable account” process stops access and revokes sessions while retaining the linked profile, order, payment, refund and support records. It is designed to allow secure reactivation; it is not represented as automatic permanent deletion of all personal data. Contact the organisation separately to request erasure or discuss which records still need to be retained.

We may suspend relevant access for a credible security risk, serious misuse or legal requirement. Where practical and lawful, we should explain the reason and how to request review. We may temporarily withhold details that would compromise an investigation or another person’s privacy, but restrictions should not be arbitrary or broader than necessary.

Disabling or suspending an account does not itself cancel a delivery, settle a debt, release the store from an approved refund, or require a customer to waive a claim. We will provide an appropriate alternative channel for unresolved matters. Any restriction on creating another account must be justified by the underlying issue rather than imposed solely because a customer complained.

sections.title: 30. Responsibility, warranties and limits
paragraphs: We are responsible for supplying the goods and services we agree to provide and for legal duties that apply to our role. Descriptions of technology as “as available” do not exclude mandatory standards for food quality, safety, accurate information or reasonable service. We cannot disclaim every direct loss, personal injury or privacy failure simply by describing CimessInvest as a platform.

To the extent permitted by law, we do not promise to cover remote or unforeseeable losses unrelated to the transaction, or business profits that were never part of the agreed consumer purchase. Responsibility depends on the cause of the loss, the duties owed and reasonable steps to reduce avoidable damage. This paragraph is not a fixed monetary cap on refunds or other recoverable claims.

Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded, including relevant liability for fraud, deliberate misconduct, unsafe goods, injury, data-protection violations or statutory consumer remedies. We do not require a broad consumer indemnity for ordinary use of the app. A person who intentionally causes unlawful harm remains subject to the remedies the law actually provides.

sections.title: 31. Events outside reasonable control
paragraphs: A serious event outside reasonable control, such as a severe disruption to transport or essential infrastructure, may affect performance. We should notify affected customers where practical, explain the impact, and take reasonable steps to minimise it. Calling an event exceptional does not make every ordinary operational problem a force-majeure event.

If a delivery can no longer be provided within an acceptable period, we will discuss cancellation, an agreed alternative or the refund required in the circumstances. We do not automatically retain payment for goods never supplied. Obligations that can still reasonably be performed, such as communicating about an unresolved order, should continue.

This provision does not excuse conduct that caused the problem, remove mandatory remedies or authorise indefinite delay without review. The effect of an event depends on its actual impact on the particular obligation, not merely on its being mentioned in a general announcement.

sections.title: 32. Nigerian law and interpretation
paragraphs: These terms are intended for a service operated in Nigeria and are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, subject to any mandatory rule that applies to the particular customer or transaction. A court or regulator with lawful jurisdiction remains available. We do not require you to surrender a mandatory right to a forum or remedy through a general website clause.

If a provision cannot lawfully be enforced, it is to be limited or separated as the law requires without automatically invalidating the remainder. A failure to enforce a term on one occasion is not necessarily a waiver on every occasion. Headings assist reading and do not override the substance of a provision.

Any transfer of the store’s relevant business or obligations should preserve existing customer rights and be communicated where required. The entire-agreement principle does not erase a specific promise made for your order, a misleading statement on which you reasonably relied, or a protection that the law supplies independently of this document.

sections.title: 33. No investment, banking or merchant-settlement product
paragraphs: The CimessInvest name does not make a CimessFruit purchase an investment. CimessFruit sells goods through the store; it does not promise interest, profit-sharing, capital growth, a regulated deposit account or an investment return. Paying for fruit is not a subscription to a financial product or authority for someone to manage your money.

Return credit represents an approved order adjustment within the store’s refund workflow. It is not advertised as a transferable savings balance, a payment service for unrelated merchants, or a product that earns interest. The spending window and manual refund process described above explain how the recorded amount is handled without changing mandatory rights to a refund.

Merchant subscriptions, independent storefront creation, automatic payout schedules and platform commissions described elsewhere in the CimessInvest ecosystem do not become part of your CimessFruit consumer order unless they are separately and lawfully offered and agreed. Report anyone who uses the organisation’s branding to solicit an unauthorised investment or financial credential.

sections.title: 34. Contact, accessible copies and keeping records
paragraphs: For order issues, use in-app Support and quote the order reference. For organisation-level complaints, legal correspondence, intellectual-property notices or privacy requests, contact CimessInvest at cimessinvest@gmail.com, telephone +234 808 927 3565, or write to 54, Olude Bustop, Ipaja, Lagos, Nigeria. Identify the matter as relating to CimessFruit so it reaches the relevant operation.

Ask for an accessible or plain-text copy if the app format is difficult to read. You may keep the policies and your transaction correspondence for your records. Do not send originals of important documents or unnecessary sensitive information just to begin an enquiry. We can explain what evidence is proportionate to the matter being reviewed.

If you do not receive a useful response or remain dissatisfied, retain the correspondence and consider the external routes described in the complaints section. Nothing in this contact procedure prevents an urgent report to an appropriate authority, a request for medical assistance, or other steps reasonably needed to protect your rights or safety.

privacy.title: CimessFruit privacy policy
privacy.summary: How CimessFruit handles account, order, delivery and support information, and how to exercise your privacy choices.

sections.title: 1. Scope and organisation contact
paragraphs: This policy describes personal information used for CimessFruit accounts, shopping, delivery, support and refunds on the mobile app and authorised store website. CimessFruit operates within the CimessInvest organisation. It does not follow that information from every unrelated CimessInvest merchant storefront is combined into your CimessFruit account or available to every merchant.

For questions or requests, contact CimessInvest at cimessinvest@gmail.com, +234 808 927 3565, or 54, Olude Bustop, Ipaja, Lagos, Nigeria, and identify your request as a CimessFruit privacy matter. These are organisation contact channels, not a claim that a named person has been appointed as a statutory data protection officer. We will route your request to the person responsible for handling it.

sections.title: 2. Information you provide
paragraphs: Account information can include your name, email, phone number, profile image, account status and password credentials. Delivery information can include your selected zone, written address, house or entrance details, landmarks and coordinates you confirm. We use the information needed for the feature you choose; an optional delivery pin is different from ongoing access to your location.

Orders record selected goods, quantities, prices, delivery details, status and relevant timestamps. Payment review and refund records can include a transfer reference, the amount involved, supporting material and bank details you nominate for a refund. Support messages and uploaded evidence are also associated with the matter being handled. Do not provide banking passwords, PINs or bank-issued authorisation codes.

sections.title: 3. Information from devices and service activity
paragraphs: Requests to the website and API necessarily involve technical information such as network addressing, request paths, times and browser or application characteristics. Security, operational and error records may help identify failed requests, attempted misuse and service faults. The precise records held depend on the hosting and service configuration, and must be limited to a legitimate operational purpose.

The app stores information needed for sessions, the basket, selected preferences and some in-progress activity. Where push notifications are enabled, the service records an installation identifier, platform and push delivery token associated with the account session. A delivery token identifies a notification destination; it does not give us access to all files, messages or applications on your device.

sections.title: 4. Information from other sources
paragraphs: When you choose Google sign-in, the provider supplies the identity and profile information permitted by that authentication flow, such as an email address, name and profile image. The service also receives administrative updates needed to process orders and feedback from providers about events such as email or notification delivery. We do not use these terms as permission to collect your private social messages.

Someone ordering for you may supply your delivery details. We expect them to have authority to do so and to tell you about the delivery. Contact us if your details were provided without authority or are inaccurate. We should assess the request without unnecessarily revealing the ordering customer’s information or another person’s account records.

sections.title: 5. Purposes and lawful grounds
paragraphs: We use information to create and secure accounts, respond to shopping requests, record orders, verify transfers, arrange delivery, address complaints and carry out refunds. Depending on the activity, the applicable basis may be taking steps toward or performing a contract, complying with a legal obligation, or a properly assessed legitimate interest such as preventing fraud and securing the service.

Where consent is the appropriate basis, it must be specific and capable of being withdrawn. Optional promotional notifications and a device permission are not blanket consent for every purpose. We must not rely on a label such as “legitimate interests” without considering the effect on you, or collect additional data merely because it could become useful for a different business in the future.

sections.title: 6. Required and optional information
paragraphs: We need enough information to authenticate an account, communicate about an order, identify a payment and deliver to a serviceable address. If necessary information is missing, the relevant feature or purchase may not be available. We should explain the reason rather than claiming that every optional profile field is required by law.

You can choose not to provide a map pin or optional photographs, although suitable written directions or another way of describing a complaint may still be needed. Declining marketing or a device permission does not automatically prevent access to all services. If we need additional evidence for a particular dispute or security check, the request should be proportionate to that purpose.

sections.title: 7. Location and map services
paragraphs: Location permission is requested when you use a feature such as finding your current location; on Android, an address lookup for a selected pin can also involve a permission request. You can instead enter an address manually. Coordinates are saved to the relevant address or order when you confirm them, and help determine coverage and locate a delivery entrance.

The current app does not use background location tracking. Map rendering and geocoding can involve Google, Apple or the platform’s map provider under its own service conditions. Review the pin and suggested address because they may be inaccurate. Change location permissions in device settings whenever you wish; removing a permission does not automatically erase coordinates already saved with an order.

sections.title: 8. Photographs, evidence and sensitive details
paragraphs: Photo or camera access supports the image selection you initiate. Support evidence may reveal more than the product problem, so crop or redact unrelated people, addresses, balances and transactions where practical. Avoid submitting identity documents, medical records or information about children unless it is necessary for a specific request and an appropriate handling method has been explained.

A food-safety complaint or dietary message may incidentally reveal health information. Give only what is needed for the issue. Any sensitive personal information must be handled on an appropriate legal basis and with additional care. Permission to investigate a complaint does not authorise publication of your photograph or medical circumstances in advertising.

sections.title: 9. People who handle your information
paragraphs: Authorised store and support personnel use relevant account, order, complaint and refund information. Delivery personnel need the recipient’s contact details, location and practical instructions for the assigned delivery. Staff access should reflect their duties. A rider should not receive your password credentials, unrelated order history or refund bank details simply to bring an order to your door.

CimessInvest’s involvement in operating the service does not mean unrestricted access across all of its activities. Internal sharing and service-provider access must have a defined purpose. Information may also be disclosed where reasonably necessary and lawful for professional advice, a genuine dispute, a competent authority’s request or a business transfer with appropriate protection for existing rights.

sections.title: 10. Technology providers
paragraphs: The service uses hosting and database infrastructure and providers for specific functions. The current implementation integrates Resend for transactional email, Cloudinary or configured object storage for product images, and Cloudflare R2 for private evidence storage. Product photographs are intended to be public; customer evidence is handled through access-controlled application routes rather than intentionally published as catalogue imagery.

Where enabled, Expo push services and the relevant Apple or Google delivery infrastructure carry notifications; Upstash QStash supports notification jobs, and Redis can support caching and live updates. Google sign-in and map providers have their own roles. A provider listed here may not be active in every deployment or app build. Contact us for details relevant to your use rather than assuming every listed service receives all categories of your data.

sections.title: 11. Marketing and notification choices
paragraphs: Essential communications concern matters such as security, verification, an order, a dispute or a refund. Optional catalogue notifications are controlled separately where offered. You can change the available preference in the app and notification permissions on your device. Blocking all device notifications can also hide useful order updates, so check the order page for the recorded status.

This notice does not authorise selling your personal information, uploading your address book, or using private complaint evidence for behavioural advertising. The current shopping terms do not enrol you in an investment promotion or an unrelated CimessInvest mailing list. A new marketing purpose needs its own appropriate basis and information, including a suitable way to object or withdraw consent.

sections.title: 12. Local storage, sessions and cookies
paragraphs: The website uses session cookies for authentication and local storage for functions such as remembering a basket. The native app uses protected device storage for its session credentials, and local application storage or caches for selected state and drafts. These records serve different purposes from a third-party advertising profile.

You can sign out, clear browser data, change device settings or remove the app, but the consequences differ: clearing a basket does not cancel a saved order, and uninstalling does not erase the account held by the store. The app’s current storage choices are not a promise that every local record survives device replacement or is immediately removed from every backup when you sign out.

sections.title: 13. International processing
paragraphs: Some providers may store or access information outside Nigeria, depending on their infrastructure and the configured service. Cross-border processing must have an appropriate basis and safeguards under applicable data-protection law. Using the app is not treated as unlimited express consent to transfer information to any country for any purpose.

You may ask about the destinations, provider categories and safeguards relevant to your information. We should explain the applicable arrangements, subject to legitimate security and confidentiality limits, rather than claim that a provider’s general reputation alone establishes compliance. Changes in provider or location should be assessed against the original purpose and any notice or consent requirement.

sections.title: 14. Retention and review
paragraphs: Account and transaction information is retained according to its purpose, including providing the account, completing orders and refunds, investigating disputes, maintaining necessary accounting records and meeting legal obligations. Relevant factors include whether a transaction or complaint is open, what record a law requires, and whether a legal claim reasonably requires preservation. A hypothetical future use is not an unlimited retention justification.

The current account-disabling process retains the linked profile and order, payment, refund and support history. It does not automatically implement an erasure schedule for all of those records. You can request review of what remains necessary. Where information is no longer required and no applicable exception justifies retaining it, it should be deleted or appropriately anonymised through the organisation’s retention process.

Temporary records have separate technical lifecycles. Unattached upload drafts currently expire after seven days and are eligible for cleanup; expired session, verification and rate-limit records are also eligible for scheduled cleanup. Expiry is not a guarantee of deletion at that exact instant. Attached evidence, backups and completed financial records are treated according to their own purpose and applicable retention needs. Contact us for the criteria or period for a particular category.

sections.title: 15. Disabling an account is different from erasure
paragraphs: The “Disable account” action revokes sessions and prevents normal sign-in while preserving the account for potential secure reactivation. It leaves existing orders and financial obligations in place. The route or screen’s technical name may mention deletion, but the user-facing operation currently disables the account rather than promising that all information is permanently erased.

To request erasure, contact cimessinvest@gmail.com and identify the account and scope of your request without sending unnecessary sensitive documents. We will assess the request separately from account access. If records must be retained for a lawful reason, we should explain the relevant limitation and restrict their use appropriately; we should not reject the request solely because account reactivation might be convenient later.

sections.title: 16. Your rights and requests
paragraphs: Under applicable data-protection law, rights can include information about processing, access, correction, erasure, restriction, objection, portability where applicable, and protection in relation to certain automated decisions. You may withdraw consent where processing relies on it. Rights are subject to their legal conditions; withdrawing consent does not automatically make earlier lawful processing unlawful.

Write to the organisation contact with the right you wish to exercise and enough detail to locate the relevant record. We may take proportionate steps to verify identity and protect other people’s information. We should respond within the applicable legal period and explain any valid extension, limitation or refusal. You do not need to purchase something or accept marketing to make a privacy request.

sections.title: 17. Automated checks and human review
paragraphs: The application uses automated checks for matters such as stock availability, delivery-zone boundaries, duplicate submissions, reservation expiry, rate limits and credit balances. These checks support the ordering workflow. Payment verification and decisions on disputes and manual refunds involve the store’s review; a machine-generated status can still be disputed if it is inaccurate.

Contact support if a check wrongly blocks an order, location or refund, or if you want a person to consider the relevant circumstances. We should investigate material errors and respect applicable rights concerning decisions with significant effects. A technical rule must not be presented as beyond review simply because it appears in the application.

sections.title: 18. Security and incidents
paragraphs: The service uses measures such as hashed passwords, restricted account access, session controls and authenticated access to private evidence. Security also depends on deployment configuration, staff practices and providers. No online service can honestly guarantee that every possible intrusion, error or disclosure is impossible.

Report suspected misuse or an unexpected disclosure promptly, avoiding further circulation of the exposed information. We will assess incidents, take appropriate containment and remedial steps, and make notifications to affected people or authorities when required. A security incident is not automatically excused by a general disclaimer or the involvement of a third-party provider.

sections.title: 19. Children and information about other people
paragraphs: The account and purchasing service is intended for adults aged 18 or over. We do not ask children to create purchasing accounts. If a child’s information is submitted without appropriate authority, contact us so we can assess the circumstances and take suitable action. An adult arranging a delivery should provide their own practical contact information where possible.

Do not use support uploads to disclose unrelated children, family members or bystanders. If another person’s details are necessary for an authorised delivery, share only what the delivery requires. Providing a recipient’s address is not permission to use that person’s details for unrelated marketing or to create an account in their name.

sections.title: 20. Complaints and policy changes
paragraphs: If you are dissatisfied with our handling of a privacy request, ask for review through cimessinvest@gmail.com. You may also contact the Nigeria Data Protection Commission through its official website, ndpc.gov.ng, and use other remedies available under law. Contacting us first may help resolve an issue, but this policy does not impose an absolute condition that prevents a complaint to the regulator.

This policy’s version and revision date identify the text provided. We will update it when relevant practices change and give additional notice where required. A revised notice does not retrospectively authorise an incompatible use of information already collected. Keep a copy if you need a record of what was disclosed when you used the service.

refunds.title: Cancellations and refunds
refunds.summary: How to cancel an order, report a problem, use approved credit or receive a manual refund. Applicable consumer rights remain protected.

sections.title: 1. Scope and consumer rights
paragraphs: This policy explains the current CimessFruit workflow for cancellations, order problems, approved return credit and manual refunds. Read it with the Terms and conditions. Operational states and buttons help administer a request; they do not replace the rights and remedies available under Nigerian law.

The store assesses the actual goods, payment and circumstances. We do not apply a blanket rule that all food sales are non-refundable. Natural deterioration after inappropriate storage may be relevant, but a perishable product must still match its material description and meet applicable quality and safety requirements when supplied.

sections.title: 2. Cancelling before payment
paragraphs: Use the cancellation action on an unpaid order while it is available. Unreported unpaid reservations currently expire after 24 hours, with stock released by scheduled maintenance. Check an order’s current eligibility before transferring rather than relying on an old screenshot or saved bank instruction.

If you have already sent money, do not treat the order as unpaid merely because its status has not updated. Report the transfer, keep the order reference and contact support. An order cancellation or reservation expiry is not an automatic bank reversal and does not make received funds the store’s property without an obligation to account for them.

sections.title: 3. Changes after payment or preparation
paragraphs: Contact the store promptly if you need to cancel or change a paid order. Explain whether payment was sent, whether it was reported and what fulfilment stage you see. The store should confirm whether a change can be made and explain any reasonable, lawful charge before you agree.

There is no automatic cancellation penalty created by this document. Applicable law, the nature of the goods and the work actually undertaken affect the outcome. If the store cannot provide what was agreed, an offered substitute should be accepted by you rather than imposed as the only way to recover value from the payment.

sections.title: 4. Reporting missing, wrong, damaged or unsafe products
paragraphs: Send the order reference, affected item and quantity, a description of the problem and any useful photographs. Contact promptly after delivery where practical, because food condition changes. A delay may affect evidence, but there is no arbitrary 20-minute deadline for reporting every defect or making a lawful claim.

Do not consume unsafe food, preserve hazardous goods unnecessarily or travel with them without suitable instructions. Photos and packaging are helpful when reasonably available; inability to upload a file should not prevent a complaint by phone or email. Avoid sending banking credentials or unrelated personal information as evidence.

sections.title: 5. Review and available outcomes
paragraphs: The store reviews the issue and explains the proposed outcome. Depending on the circumstances and applicable rights, a remedy may include missing goods, a replacement, a reduction, a refund or another arrangement you accept. Request further review if the decision does not address your evidence or the right you are asserting.

Opening a dispute is not the same as approving it. The current system records an approved amount for the affected order items and any approved delivery adjustment. Internal limits designed to prevent duplicate credits must not be used to deny additional relief that is legally due and requires separate handling.

sections.title: 6. Approval starts the buying window
paragraphs: Approval currently starts a 20-minute window during which the approved value can be used to buy again or arrange an available replacement. The interface initially selects buy-again or credit. Only the amount actually approved becomes available, and the window is measured using the service’s recorded time.

A new unpaid order can reserve some of that credit. The balance is settled when the relevant order is paid or released under its cancellation process. The same amount cannot be spent twice or spent while it is locked for a refund. If a cancelled replacement releases credit after the window, contact support about the resulting refundable balance rather than assuming the money has disappeared.

sections.title: 7. Unused balances and refund preference
paragraphs: After the buying window, the unused eligible balance becomes due for manual bank refund even where credit or replacement was selected but not completed. The window is not a promise of bank receipt within 20 minutes. It is also not a deadline to complain, a requirement to make another purchase or a forfeiture provision.

If you want a bank refund rather than to buy again, use the available resolution choice and tell support if the screen does not reflect your instruction. A default selection is not an agreement to surrender a mandatory refund right. Where the technical workflow does not meet a required remedy, the store must arrange an appropriate alternative.

sections.title: 8. Bank details and manual processing
paragraphs: Use the designated form to supply the bank name, recipient account details and account holder information needed for your refund. These are your nominated refund details, not bank passwords, PINs or payment authorisation codes. Check the details carefully and notify support of a mistake before the transfer is made.

The store locks the refund balance while preparing a manual transfer. It records completion and a transfer reference after payment, or releases a lock when a transfer is cancelled before money is sent. Support should tell you the amount and expected next step, provide appropriate updates, and investigate if the recorded transfer is not received.

sections.title: 9. Delivery charges, partial refunds and duplicate payments
paragraphs: Delivery charges and partial item returns are assessed separately. A partial problem does not always require reversing an entire completed order, but the remedy must address the actual loss and applicable legal entitlement. A system setting that requires approval of a delivery refund is an administrative step, not a waiver of your rights.

If you sent too much, paid twice or transferred to an expired order, provide the reference and limited bank confirmation so the store can reconcile the funds. A rejected payment report does not prove that a bank refund occurred. Do not send another payment solely to make an unresolved status change.

sections.title: 10. Account access and escalation
paragraphs: Disabling an account does not settle or cancel an outstanding refund. If you cannot sign in, use cimessinvest@gmail.com or +234 808 927 3565 and provide the order reference through a suitable identity-checking process. The organisation contact is CimessInvest, 54, Olude Bustop, Ipaja, Lagos, Nigeria.

Ask for a review if a remedy is refused or materially delayed without explanation. Keep correspondence and payment records. You may use the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission’s official complaint channels and other competent legal routes. This policy does not require compulsory arbitration or prevent urgent action to protect your rights.

delivery.title: Delivery information
delivery.summary: Coverage, address confirmation, delivery progress, receiving perishables and getting help with a delivery.

sections.title: 1. Available zones and charges
paragraphs: CimessFruit delivers within the active zones shown by the store. Checkout displays the delivery charge and available estimate for the selected location. A saved address does not guarantee that delivery remains available there on every future date; check the current order before paying.

Where a pin falls outside a configured boundary, contact support instead of selecting an inaccurate location to bypass the check. A boundary can contain errors and may be reviewed, but support must confirm a workable arrangement before you rely on it. The store should not add an undisclosed delivery fee after payment without addressing the issue with you.

sections.title: 2. Confirming an address
paragraphs: Provide the street or close, house number, entrance or flat details, recipient phone number and a helpful landmark where needed. Review automatically suggested text because map addresses may be incomplete. A pin and clear written directions work together; neither should contradict the actual delivery destination.

You can enter the address manually if you decline location permission. Use another person’s contact details only with appropriate authority and tell the recipient to expect the delivery. Do not place passwords, alarm codes or unnecessary personal information in directions that a rider needs to read.

sections.title: 3. Changes to a saved order
paragraphs: An order retains the delivery details confirmed at checkout. Changing your profile does not automatically rewrite an order already submitted. Contact support immediately if the address or recipient is wrong, and wait for confirmation that the requested change can be made.

A different zone or journey may require a revised agreement about delivery. The store should explain any proposed charge or inability to fulfil the change. If the arrangement cannot proceed, the cancellation and refund policies and applicable consumer rights determine the next step; the original payment is not automatically forfeited.

sections.title: 4. Preparation and progress updates
paragraphs: The current process verifies a reported bank transfer before the store prepares and dispatches the order. Selecting “I have paid” does not itself start delivery. The order page records the available progress states, and notifications provide an additional way to learn of updates.

The app does not promise live rider tracking merely because a map pin is available. A saved delivery coordinate is not a continuous tracking feed. Contact support if a status is unclear or inconsistent with what happened, and avoid creating another order simply because a notification was delayed.

sections.title: 5. Timing and delays
paragraphs: Quoted times are estimates unless an express guarantee is agreed for the particular order. Preparation, traffic, weather and access can affect arrival. The store should communicate a material delay and discuss an appropriate solution, especially when timely delivery was an important part of the agreement.

An estimate is not permission for indefinite delay or silence. If the store cannot supply within an acceptable period, contact support about cancellation, an agreed alternative or the remedy required by law. Do not infer that an expired estimate means a transfer was automatically reversed.

sections.title: 6. Receipt, access and missed delivery
paragraphs: Arrange for an authorised person to receive the order and respond to practical delivery contact. Provide safe access instructions and tell the store about a material obstacle. Riders are not required to enter a dangerous location or undertake an unrelated task to complete an ordinary delivery.

If delivery fails, the store should explain the reason and agree a next step. Responsibility for a reasonable redelivery charge depends on the facts and must be explained before acceptance. An unattended drop-off or handover to an unrelated person is not automatically authorised by these terms. Report a “delivered” status if the goods were not actually received.

sections.title: 7. Checking and caring for food
paragraphs: Check the goods as soon as reasonably possible for the correct items, quantities, packaging and condition. Follow appropriate storage instructions promptly. If something appears unsafe, do not consume it; contact the store for help and keep useful evidence only where safe and practical.

Perishability matters when assessing condition, but does not remove rights concerning wrong, damaged, spoiled or otherwise non-conforming goods. Report a problem promptly and explain any reason evidence or immediate contact was not possible. The refund policy describes the review process and available resolutions.

sections.title: 8. Delivery support and organisation contact
paragraphs: Use in-app Support with the order reference for an address problem, a missing delivery or a delay. If the app is unavailable, contact CimessInvest for CimessFruit assistance at cimessinvest@gmail.com or +234 808 927 3565. The organisation address is 54, Olude Bustop, Ipaja, Lagos, Nigeria.

Do not send a new transfer to a rider or an unsolicited contact without verifying that it is a legitimate, agreed instruction. Payment instructions belong on the saved order. Keep relevant messages and seek review if the delivery response does not resolve the issue; your applicable consumer rights remain in place.
